name: withProgressShiny
title: Use Progressr in Shiny Apps: Plug-in Backward-Compatible Replacement for shiny::withProgress()

origin.description: Evaluate an expression under shiny::withProgress() and progressr handlers.
origin.usage: withProgressShiny(expr, ..., message = NULL, detail = NULL, inputs = list(message = NULL, detail = "message"), env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE, handlers = c(shiny = handler_shiny, progressr::handlers(default = NULL)))

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: R delays the expression. Python takes a zero-argument callable and does not call it before the shiny lookup.

arguments.name: message, detail
arguments.text: Text passed toward shiny::withProgress(). An input attribute can retarget that field.

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Sources for message and detail. The default detail source is "message".

arguments.name: handlers
arguments.text: Handlers for the inner with_progress(). The default names handler_shiny as shiny.

arguments.name: quoted
arguments.text: If FALSE, R captures expr with substitute(). The expression still does not run before the package lookup.

origin.details: The default handlers list is built, then shiny::withProgress is looked up. shiny is not installed, so 1 + 1 never runs.
origin.value: The value of shiny::withProgress(). On this machine the call stops before that.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(withProgressShiny(1 + 1), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("withProgressShiny(1 + 1) errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Evaluate a callable under the Shiny progress wrapper.
translation.usage: with_progress_shiny(expr, *args, message=None, detail=None, inputs=None, env=None, quoted=False, handlers=<missing>)

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: R delays the expression. Python takes a zero-argument callable and does not call it before the shiny lookup.

arguments.name: message, detail
arguments.text: Text passed toward shiny::withProgress(). An input attribute can retarget that field.

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Sources for message and detail. The default detail source is "message".

arguments.name: handlers
arguments.text: Handlers for the inner with_progress(). The default names handler_shiny as shiny.

arguments.name: quoted
arguments.text: If FALSE, R captures expr with substitute(). The expression still does not run before the package lookup.

translation.details: Python would already have evaluated a bare 1 + 1, so expr is a callable. The callable is not called. The missing shiny namespace stops the call first.
translation.value: The value of shiny::withProgress(). On this machine the call stops before that.
